review_text: Very cozy place. I like the venue concept. Variety food choices. Price is just right. Great service !!!

Update '25: boring. No music. Slow service. Slow kitchen. Taste reduced. There is only a shadow from the Hikaru from '23. We tried three time in a distance around 3 month. Always the same. Hikaru calls itself a "Cafe", but it is much more than this. Cafe, restaurant, Bar. Very good food from a rich menu, until now everything on stock (Do i miss "Sorry sir, it's not available"? No.). Different cold beer including imported and "my" Sm Light, Cocktails... good variety of cocktails! And they are mixed with passion and served well decorated! Also Live Music on Friday, Sat, Sunday. Sometimes outside, makes a nice bar feeling, sometimes inside, makes a Pub feeling. The new (and only?) Star on the Calinan Gastronomic night star! We only had one real good restaurant close to Calinan, 2, maybe 3 places more you can call a "restaurant" if you already experienced in good dining culture. Very nice decoration, very attentive Staff, Aircon is not too cold. We will become regular customers there. Five Stars would be the right for downtown Davao. For Calinan it should be 6*. Keep up the good work! PS: very cool: You have a Car wash beside! So while your car is cleaned, you can eat and drink while you are waiting. Most of the food and the beer is affordable (but not cheap...), cocktails & Steaks are more expensive. Quality needs price. You get a great return for your money!
You have to try their cheesy Bolognese and salted caramel latte. They're amazing!

Poor service. We waited almost an hour for a whole pizza, and it wasn't worth the wait. When we went there, many menu options were not available. I ordered the carbonara with garlic bread on the side. The picture showed a red sauce, but when it arrived, it had a white sauce and no garlic bread. I wouldn't recommend this place if you're a busy person or have high expectations.

I experienced bad service from them. I went around 3:30PM to order take out food. When my niece and I arrived, there were no other customers, just us, and no service crew. We understood that maybe it wasn't "peak" time yet so there were no crews to be seen watching or waiting. When our order was taken, it took a long time to be served to think that we were the only customers during that time. It took about 1hr. before our order (pizza and carbonara) was served. If I hadn't followed up, they wouldn't have served it. I can't say they were busy because there were no Grab drivers coming and going to take online orders, and the crews were just playing around. :( :-/
It takes too long to serve the food and the crew has low rapport with the customers. Food is so-so. Price is expensive.
